title: Japan: 100,000 carp swept away by flooding in Chiba after typhoon

blocks.text: Around 100,000 Nishikigoi ornamental carp ready for sale were swept away after heavy rain caused by a typhoon breached some levees at a lake in Chiba Prefecture near Tokyo, it has been revealed as authorities assess the widespread damage to local farming and fisheries. Typhoon Dujuan, which approached the region about a week ago, inundated rice paddy fields and other farmland while flooding facilities where carp and eels were being cultivated near Lake Imbanuma in northern Chiba. Kenji Tani, who runs an aquafarm in Narita, realized the severity of the damage after returning home last Tuesday from an overseas trip to […]...
